instruction: Write an XDP program that inspects network traffic and must verify source host IP against BPF_MAP_TYPE_HASH map 'blocked_knock_map' dropping blocked traffic. Forward all other packets with XDP_PASS.
requirements: Define BPF_MAP_TYPE_HASH map 'blocked_knock_map' with key __u32 and max_entries 512
Verify Ethernet and IPv4 header bounds against data_end
Drop packet with XDP_DROP if lookup succeeds (host is blocked)
SEC("xdp") entry point and GPL license declaration
